entities.name: UniProt:A4FA49
observations: Exact sequence match to reviewed Saccharopolyspora erythraea 3-methyl-2-oxobutanoate hydroxymethyltransferase; sequence length 293 aa.
Sequence-derived estimates: 31,303.9 Da; pI 5.72; GRAVY −0.209; instability index 42.53.
UniProt annotation: EC 2.1.2.11; catalyzes reversible ketopantoate formation from 3-methyl-2-oxobutanoate and 5,10-methylene-THF.
Binds one Mg2+ per subunit; annotated cytoplasmic and homodecameric (pentamer of dimers).
Annotated in pantothenate biosynthesis; GO:0003864 enzyme activity, GO:0000287 magnesium binding, GO:0015940 pantothenate biosynthesis.

entities.name: RHEA:11824
observations: Reversible transfer reaction: 5,10-methylene-THF plus 3-methyl-2-oxobutanoate and water yields 2-dehydropantoate and tetrahydrofolate.

entities.name: GO:0015940 pantothenate biosynthesis
observations: The exact-match enzyme is annotated in the pantothenate biosynthetic process, producing the pantoate intermediate.

entities.name: CHEBI:18420 magnesium ion
observations: UniProt annotation reports one Mg2+ ion bound per enzyme subunit.
